atoms.exact_source_text: Routine facts remain in the Register that produced them.
atoms.normalized_claim: Routine facts remain in the Register that produced them.

atoms.exact_source_text: A pantry total changing, a Project completing, rain beginning, a Readiness Margin narrowing, or a Reach becoming slower does not by itself justify a modal scene.
atoms.normalized_claim: A pantry total changing, a Project completing, rain beginning, a Readiness Margin narrowing, or a Reach becoming slower does not by itself justify a modal scene.

atoms.exact_source_text: A situation earns MEET when enough of the following are present:
atoms.normalized_claim: A situation earns MEET when enough of the following listed conditions are present.

atoms.exact_source_text: a genuine choice
atoms.normalized_claim: A situation earns MEET when a genuine choice is present as one of the threshold conditions.

atoms.exact_source_text: named or socially meaningful participation
atoms.normalized_claim: A situation earns MEET when named or socially meaningful participation is present as one of the threshold conditions.

atoms.exact_source_text: competing needs
atoms.normalized_claim: A situation earns MEET when competing needs are present as one of the threshold conditions.

atoms.exact_source_text: uncertain or costly outcome
atoms.normalized_claim: A situation earns MEET when an uncertain or costly outcome is present as one of the threshold conditions.

atoms.exact_source_text: opportunity or danger
atoms.normalized_claim: A situation earns MEET when opportunity or danger is present as one of the threshold conditions.

atoms.exact_source_text: persistent consequence
atoms.normalized_claim: A situation earns MEET when persistent consequence is present as one of the threshold conditions.

atoms.exact_source_text: a reason to stop surveying and attend
atoms.normalized_claim: A situation earns MEET when there is a reason to stop surveying and attend, as one of the threshold conditions.

atoms.exact_source_text: Information remains native.
atoms.normalized_claim: Information remains native.

atoms.exact_source_text: Consequential interaction becomes MEET.
atoms.normalized_claim: Consequential interaction becomes MEET.

atoms.exact_source_text: The fixed MEET presentation is itself a promise: this moment deserves attention and may be remembered.
atoms.normalized_claim: The fixed MEET presentation is itself a promise that this moment deserves attention and may be remembered.

atoms.exact_source_text: If every small change seizes the camera, MEET loses dramatic weight and DWELL becomes an alarm dashboard.
atoms.normalized_claim: If every small change seizes the camera, MEET loses dramatic weight and DWELL becomes an alarm dashboard.

atoms.exact_source_text: The threshold therefore protects both attachment-first play and successful stillness.
atoms.normalized_claim: The threshold therefore protects both attachment-first play and successful stillness.

atoms.exact_source_text: The player attends an open Place, Project, or known situation whose resolution requires MEET.
atoms.normalized_claim: For DWELL, the player goes to it by attending an open Place, Project, or known situation whose resolution requires MEET.

atoms.exact_source_text: A Colony situation reaches the threshold and calls attention.
atoms.normalized_claim: For DWELL, it comes to the player when a Colony situation reaches the threshold and calls attention.

atoms.exact_source_text: The party enters a Node or deliberately approaches a known Presence.
atoms.normalized_claim: For TRAVEL, the player goes to it by the party entering a Node or deliberately approaching a known Presence.

atoms.exact_source_text: A Field card or environmental interruption finds the party.
atoms.normalized_claim: For TRAVEL, it comes to the player when a Field card or environmental interruption finds the party.

atoms.exact_source_text: RISK                | Not normally applicable
atoms.normalized_claim: For RISK, the player-goes-to-it column is not normally applicable.

atoms.exact_source_text: the Register is already direct embodied action.
atoms.normalized_claim: For RISK, the Register is already direct embodied action.

atoms.exact_source_text: Not normally applicable.
atoms.normalized_claim: For RISK, the it-comes-to-the-player column is not normally applicable.

atoms.exact_source_text: No consequential MEET is nested inside an EMBODY experience.
atoms.normalized_claim: For EMBODY, no consequential MEET is nested inside an EMBODY experience.

atoms.exact_source_text: An urgent crisis ends eligibility or closes the experience rather than ambushing it with a decision modal.
atoms.normalized_claim: For EMBODY, an urgent crisis ends eligibility or closes the experience rather than ambushing it with a decision modal.

atoms.exact_source_text: The Field cadence guardrail remains: Nodes are the meal
atoms.normalized_claim: The Field cadence guardrail remains that Nodes are the meal.

atoms.exact_source_text: cards are the weather.
atoms.normalized_claim: Under the Field cadence guardrail, cards are the weather.

atoms.exact_source_text: When interruptions become the principal content of travel, territory has stopped being readable.
atoms.normalized_claim: When interruptions become the principal content of travel, territory has stopped being readable.
